summary: Suncor Energy Inc. filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on May 5, 2026, reporting the declaration of a regular quarterly dividend of $0.60 per share on its common shares, payable June 25, 2026 to shareholders of record on June 4, 2026. This is a routine dividend declaration, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or management change is involved.
